comment: Static Go launcher artifacts (plan: go-launcher-static-binary). Linux amd64 and arm64 only — macOS, Windows, and armhf are explicitly out of scope. The arm64 artifact is also the Raspberry Pi 64-bit binary. Built by scripts/build-launcher.sh with CGO_ENABLED=0 and -trimpath so the binary is fully static and reproducible.
excludedTargetsReason: macOS, Windows, and armhf/32-bit Raspberry Pi are explicitly out of scope for the static launcher (plan: go-launcher-static-binary).
